notes.title: Update description on March 12
notes.content:
hello everyone!

We have made the following updates to the game:

1. We modified the monster's ui, and when the monster's health value reaches a certain standard, it will turn red. We think this can increase the player's game experience.

2. We have added a return key in the plot mode to facilitate the operation of players.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 3/11 Update Description
notes.content:
hello everyone!

We have made the following updates to the game:

1 Three new languages have been added, namely Korean, Japanese and English. We put them in eye-catching positions for players to use them;

2. We changed the ui design, and we hope to make the ui more in line with the player's aesthetic;

3. We have enhanced the enemy and optimized the player's role, which we hope will enhance the player's game experience.

4 We have added a new plot mode, which can help players understand the story of their characters. Although there is only one level now.

5 In the future, we plan to update the game every Sunday or so, and fix the bugs immediately after they are found.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 3月8号更新说明
notes.content:
大家好！
我们对游戏进行了以下更新：
1.对人物的ui进行调整；
      1.不再显示血量；当人物的血量低于1/2时，人物ui将发生一些变化；当人物的血量低于1/4时ui将发生更大的变化。
     2.人物的攻击等级将不再ui上面显示，当你升级你的攻击等级时，你的人物将发生一些变化。
    3.我们对一些关卡进行了一系列的优化；比如:我们在阶梯上面做了陷阱，所以，请注意不要在上面待太多时间。
     4.我们对绿胖进行了重做，不再按shift键加速，而是初始速度高于其它角色。
